code='''def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    pts = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(g) for c, v in enumerate(row) if v == 2]
    if not pts:
        return g
    r0 = min(r for r, c in pts); c0 = min(c for r, c in pts)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in pts]
    sh, sw = max(r for r,c in shape)+1, max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(g[r+dr][c+dc] == 0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape:
                    g[r+dr][c+dc] = 2
    return g
'''
